packageRules.description: The AWS SDK ships ~35 separately versioned modules that release in lockstep. Ungrouped, they would never drain at prConcurrentLimit 1.

The workflows' go-version inputs (depName `go`) and the two .tool-versions pins (depNames `golang` and `golangci-lint`) all track the same toolchain; bump them in one PR. golangci-lint especially cannot lag: it type-checks through a vendored x/tools that only reads export data from Go releases it already knows about.

A pin fixes a floating tag to the version already in use, so there is no newer release to age. Renovate synthesizes pin updates with no releaseTimestamp, and the default minimumReleaseAgeBehaviour of timestamp-required holds those pending forever.
